subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should visible reasoning formatting be a shared agent presentation setting with optional channel overrides, or should each channel own its display policy through a portable presentation contract?
rationale: The formatter is shared across agent output paths, but styles such as spoilers and blockquotes have channel-specific support and escaping behavior; code alone cannot choose the durable public configuration and fallback contract.

options.title: Shared contract plus channel overrides
options.body: Define a portable agent-level default and allow channel plugins to override only supported presentation styles with documented fallbacks.

options.title: Agent-level setting only
options.body: Expose one cross-channel style vocabulary and map unsupported styles to the compatibility format in channel adapters.

options.title: Telegram-only policy
options.body: Keep the change inside the Telegram plugin and defer a generic setting until multiple channels need the same capability.

recommendation.title: Shared contract plus channel overrides
recommendation.body: Define a portable agent-level default and allow channel plugins to override only supported presentation styles with documented fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reasoning projection and agent-output paths are central to the configuration boundary being chosen.
